newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr ends stronger on U.S. employment data.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr ends stronger on U.S. employment data.

text.p: * The Canadian dollar made a strong leap on Tuesday to close at C$1.3397 (US$0.7465) from Monday's close of C$1.3437 (US$0.7443), rallying on a benevolent report on U.S. labor costs in the fourth quarter, traders said. * They said some market players were caught short by the report, prompting a buying spree in the Canadian currency.
Fund managers who expected stronger numbers were caught short Canadian dollars after the report came out, traders said.
"They had to buy Canada quite aggressively," said one dealer. He said the buying interest further strengthened the currency.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.2275 marks from Monday's close of 1.2256 marks and edged up to 90.22 yen from 88.84 yen.
